name: Avtrz
description: Profile-photo enrichment — resolve a person's real LinkedIn avatar image from their profile URL or handle.

methods.label: Get Avatar
methods.description: Resolve a person's profile photo from their LinkedIn URL or handle. Provide `linkedin_url` OR `username` (the slug after /in/). Returns the resolved CDN image URL (or empty if no photo was found). Use a secret 'sk_' key.
